ValidationRule.description: Una vez que se ha clasificado un caso de EGS no se puede volver a quitarle la clasificacion.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.CIB_Bypass__c.CIB_skip_validationrule__c = false, $Setup.CIB_User_Org__c.CIB_Is_Service__c, ISPICKVAL(SER_Business_Case_Type__c, "EGS"), NOT( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( SER_Classification__c ) , "") ), NOT( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( SER_Classification__c ) , "Discarded / Duplicated") ), ISPICKVAL( SER_Classification__c , "") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Classification can't be set to "--None--" once it has been changed
